observations.behavior: Adds documentation for the `run_cron_schedule` parameter, specifying it accepts a five-field cron expression, overrides `run_interval_minutes`, and anchors execution to the edit time rather than catching up.
observations.code_quote: - `run_cron_schedule`: a five-field cron expression (`'30 9 * * *'`, `'0 9 * * 1-5'`) evaluated in the project's timezone; occurrences must be at least 30 minutes apart.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies scheduling behavior for the Signals Scout configuration, potentially relevant for users relying on wall-clock scheduling rather than rolling intervals.

observations.behavior: Updates Slack delivery documentation to clarify that suppressed reports do not reach Slack, and adds requirements for API scopes and OAuth tokens.
observations.code_quote: Set `slack` to deliver every surfaced report the scout emits (`ready` or `pending_input`) to Slack as well as the inbox; a report the judge suppressed stays out of Slack by design: an `integration_id` for the workspace, plus either a `channel` (`channel_id|#channel-name`) or up to five `users` to DM (`member_id|@display-name`), never both.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies Slack integration behavior and permission requirements, relevant for users configuring Slack notifications for Signals Scouting.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation for `posthog:scout-notes-create` with a new `skill_name` option for report pipeline research, and clarifies derived note forwarding and access requirements.
observations.code_quote: `skill_name: "pipeline:report-research"` addresses the report pipeline's research stage instead of any scout, for guidance about how the reports it builds from clustered signals get researched, judged, and routed ("route billing-adjacent reports to the billing folks"). Reports a scout authors directly never pass through that stage, so a rule for them belongs in a fleet-wide note (omit `skill_name`) or a per-scout one. It is the only `pipeline:*` audience; any other value is rejected.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies audience and routing behavior for system-derived notes, relevant for users configuring note delivery and understanding report lifecycle.
